_about: Held-out evaluation. 'heldout' was written by a separate reviewer during an outside review of this project and was never used to tune DecisionGraph: 'rep' questions revisit topics from the main test set in new words, 'new' questions are about topics the main test set never asks. 'out_of_scope' questions have no answer in the decision records; the right behaviour is to say so.
